{{nihongo|'''Kushiina Inataki-hime Shrine (Kokubu Town)'''|久志伊奈太伎比咩神社（国分町）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Noto Province]].
